meta.title: Professional Project Archive
meta.description: Structured project history for the portfolio. Enrich summaries, technologies, categories, featured flags, and live links as details become available.

projects.name: Darpon LMS
projects.summary: Darpon is a full-featured LMS web application built with Laravel and React. It provides the core functionality for an online learning management platform while also supporting online book sales.
projects.description: Darpon LMS is a comprehensive learning management and online book-commerce platform built with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js. It brings course delivery, educational content, and book sales into a unified digital experience for learners and administrators. Laravel handles the application's business logic and server-side workflows, while React and Tailwind CSS provide a responsive, accessible interface. MySQL stores structured learning and commerce data, with Redis supporting caching and efficient background processing.

projects.name: Trading Chart
projects.summary: Trading Chart is a full-featured learning management and live-streaming platform built for delivering interactive online education. It provides comprehensive LMS functionality, secure payment processing, AI-powered chat assistance, and real-time WebSocket support using Laravel Reverb.
projects.description: Trading Chart is a full-featured learning management and live-streaming platform designed for interactive online education. It combines course delivery, secure payment workflows, AI-assisted chat, and real-time user support within one connected system. Laravel powers the core application services and WebSocket communication, while React provides a responsive interface for learners and administrators. PostgreSQL manages the platform's structured data, and the AI MCP integration extends the learning experience with intelligent, contextual assistance.

projects.name: Paikari World - E-commerce
projects.summary: Paikari World is a full-featured e-commerce platform built with Laravel and React. It provides a robust and scalable solution for online shopping, with features such as whole selling settings, inventory management, payment gateway integration, and more.
projects.description: Paikari World is a scalable wholesale e-commerce platform developed with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js. It supports product catalog management, wholesale pricing configurations, inventory control, customer ordering, and payment gateway integration through a cohesive application experience. Laravel manages the commerce rules and backend workflows, while React and Tailwind CSS deliver a responsive storefront and administration interface. PostgreSQL provides reliable relational data storage, with Redis improving caching and background task performance.

projects.name: U.S. Real Estate Platform
projects.summary: A U.S.-focused real estate platform built with Laravel, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, featuring web-scraping workflows for collecting and organizing property data.
projects.description: This U.S.-focused real estate platform brings property information into a structured, searchable digital experience. Laravel powers the backend business logic and data-processing workflows, while React and TypeScript provide a responsive, maintainable frontend. PostgreSQL stores normalized property and listing data, and purpose-built web-scraping workflows collect information from external sources for centralized management. The architecture separates data acquisition, server-side processing, and presentation concerns, creating a dependable foundation for managing and exploring real estate listings.
